tei:div.tei:p: /chos drug dril ba'i gdams pa bzhugs so//

gang gis chos kun bde ba'i rang bzhin las// 'gro 'ong med don stong nyid don gzigs pa// dzñā na sid+dhir grags pa'i dpal mnga' ba// bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la phyag byas te// de las 'ongs pa'i lam srol ma log cing*// ma 'khrul don zab myur lam ston byed pa'i| |chos drug rtsa ba mdo tsam bstan 'di mtshar// de la thog mar stan bde ba la/ rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag /dpung pa thad sor brgyang*/ sgal tshigs bsrang*| mgrin pa sgur/ lce ya rkan la sbyar/ mig sna rtser phab/ de ltar lus gnad dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro bzhi las/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'// skyes bu'i don sgrub thob par gyur pa la// gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrub na// phyis nas yang dag 'byor par ga la 'gyur// 'di 'dra'i lus 'di mi rtag 'chi bar nges// gnod mang rlung gis brdas pa'i mar me bzhin// skad cig mi rtag 'jig pa'i chos can te| |'gro drug gang gi gnas su skyes gyur kyang*// bde ba'i go skabs ma mchis sdug bsngal rgyu// 'di dag dkar nag rgyu 'bras las yin phyir// thar 'dod mi dge spangs shing dge ba bsgrub// ces gsungs pa rnams kyi don dran par bya'o// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro nyams su blang ba ni/ rgyud snod rung du sgrub pa skyabs 'gro'i khrid ni/ spyi bor rin chen seng khri pad nyi'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi sku// sngo bsangs rdor dril bsnol 'dzin rin chen brgyan// nges pa lnga ldan longs sku'i tshul can la| |brgyud pa'i bla ma 'khor gyi tshul du bzhugs// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// bdag sogs nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su mchi// smon 'jug byang chub sems mchog bskyed par bgyi// lam 'dir zhugs te don gnyis sgrub la brtson// bla ma 'khor bcas dgyes tshul spyi bor bstim// gnyis pa sdig sgrib dag par byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/

spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje sems// ston zla'i mdog can dar dang rin chen brgyan// rdor dril bsnol 'dzin thugs kar zla steng hūm̐// yig brgya'i sngags las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu yi// sangs rgyas byang sems thugs rje'i 'od bsdus thim// sngags las 'od byung rang gi tshangs bug zhugs// sdig sgrib kun dag yig brgya'i bzlas par brtson// rdor sems zhal nas sdig sgrib dag ces gsungs// 'od zer dkar po'i tshul du rang la thim// gsum pa tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid ni/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal dbus su rin chen khrir// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku// dkon mchog gsum dang yi dam lha tshogs bskor// gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla'i rgyan ldan dang*// lus ngag yid gsum ltos med maṇ+ḍal dbul// tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs bla ma rang la thim// bzhi pa byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid ni/ mdun du rin chen seng khri pad zla'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sngon po// rin chen rgyan ldan phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin// lha rdzas gos can brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor// rigs rnams kun gyi mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang*// dkyil 'khor ma lus dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das// shes rab bzang po dzñā na sid+dhi'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// chos kyi blo gros bzhad pa rdo rje dang*// zla 'od mtshan can rdo rje rgyal po'i zhabs// rin chen dpal dang de sras bsod nams grags// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rdo rje grags dang rin chen seng ge'i mtshan// spyan snga mtshams bcad rdo rje rin chen dang*// rdo rje rgyal po dharma rā dza la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// don grub rgyal po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang*// rin chen dpal bzang chos rgyal rat+na dang*// rin chen chos rgyal kun dga'i mtshan mnga' ba// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mkha' grol klong yangs dharma rā dza dang*// mtshungs bral mkhan chen rnam 'joms phun tshogs zhabs// snyigs dus 'dren mchog chos kyi grags pa la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bla brgyud 'di man gsar du kha bskangs pa'o// khyab bdag brtse ldan phrin las rnam rgyal dang*// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug karma bha dra'i mtshan// rdo rje 'chang dngos don grub chos kyi rgyal// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// pad dkar 'chang ba bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul dang*// bka' drin sum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// don gnyis mchog stsol yi dam 'khor lo sdom// rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// bar chad sel mdzad chos skyong srung ma la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bde drod gtum mo'i dga' bzhi 'bar 'dzag ste// 'od gsal rmi lam sgyu lus 'pho ba dang*// bar do la sogs thabs lam zab mo 'dis// rang grol gzhan la'ang ston pa'i blo gros can// brgyud pa'i bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin gyur te// bde stong gnyis med rdo rje 'dzin thob shog

/ces gsol ba btab/ gus pas gsol btab gnas gsum 'od zer 'phros// rang gi gnas gsum thim pas sgrib gsum dag /dbang gsum thob cing bla ma 'khor dang bcas// 'od zhu rang la thim pas tshig dbang thob/ dus gsum 'bral ba med pa'i ngang du bzhag /gnyis 'dzin gyi dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir bskyed rim bsgom zhing bzlas pa bya ba ni/ stong nyid ngang las chos 'byung pad nyi'i steng*// phag mo rtsa zhal chags tshul phag mgos mtshan// dmar mo phyag na gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rin chen rus pas brgyan// thugs kar nyi steng bam̐ la sngags kyis bskor// skabs 'dir bzlas pa cung zad bya/ sngags ni/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ slar yang stong ra'i dbus su dhū ti sngo// tshangs bug gsang gnas bar slebs g.yas g.yon du// ro rkyang dkar dmar yar sne sna bug slebs| |mar sne cha dbyibs 'dus mdor tsaṇ+ḍa lī// a shad rno zhing tsha ba'i ngar ldan gsal// lte ba snying ga mgrin pa spyi bo bzhir// rtsa 'dab re bzhi brgyad dang bcu drug dang*// so gnyis tshangs bug kun+da haṃ yig dbyibs// thur bstan snying ga mgrin par yab yum gyi// sa bon rtsa mdud tshul can gsal ba la// ro rkyang rlung sbud a shad sbar ba'i mes// gnas bzhi'i rtsa mdud bkrol te haṃ reg pas// dkar cha'i rgyun byung gsang gnas bar du slebs// slar yang lugs ldog bya zhing 'bar 'dzag gsal// lus kun bde bas khyab cing sku bsring bya| |lus kyi phyi nang me lces gang gsal bsdus// ras gos mal stan me yi dkyil 'khor la// lus kyang me dpung gsang gnas a shad las// 'bar ba'i me lces lus nang gang bsam nyal// rdzogs rim stod smad 'od zhu dmigs med bzhag /skabs 'dir 'khrul 'khor gzhung nas gsal/ snying ga'i dbus nang pad steng rdo rje 'chang*// nas tsam thugs kar hū?m̐ dang thig le las| |'od 'phros lus kyi phyi nang gtams gsal zhing*// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i 'od gsal mngon du gyur// mgrin par pad steng tshon tshad rdo rje 'chang*// thugs kar oṃ dang a nu ta ra gsal// rang gi lte 'og nor bu'i rtser thig le// dkar dmar nag pa'i ngang du rmi lam bzung*// chos dang zang zing las kun rmi lam dang*/

/sgyu ma yin phyir dngos por grub pa med/ ༈ /ma dag sgyu lus me long gzugs brnyan bzhin// bstod smad dga' sdug khyad par med mod kyi// chu zla lta bur med bzhin snang bar rig /lha sku'ang snang stong grag stong rig stong ste// yod med mtha' 'das sgyu lus 'ching ba grol/ ༈ /slar yang dhū ti'i nang du lte bar a// dmar po spyi bor k+ṣa dkar snying gar hūm̐// mthing ga gsal ba'i sems kyi ngo bo la// hika gi sgras bskul a yig hūm̐ la thim// hūm̐ yang steng phyir k+ṣa yig phul bar bsam// skabs 'dir a hika mang du brjod/ 'jog dus yi ge rang rang gnas su bskyal| |las sbyor hūm̐ yig bla ma'i thugs kar bstim/ ༈ /bar dor phra rags thim pa'i snang ba ste// sa chu me rlung rnam shes 'byung ba thim// zungs mi thub cing rngul skam drod chung zhing*| |phyir dbyung dbugs ring nang du sdud mi thub// snang mched thob gsum phyi rtags zla nyi'i dbyibs// dkar lam dmar lam zhe sdang 'dod chags las// gyur pa'i rtog pa so gsum bzhi bcu 'gags// mched pa thob par thim tshe phyi rtags ni// mun pa 'dra ste gti mug las gyur pa'i// rtog pa bdun 'gags rang bzhin ma bsgom pa'i// 'od gsal sprin med nam mkha' lta bu 'byung*// de tshe shi ba shes dang gnas dang grogs// bar dor shes shing yi dam sku ru bsgom// pho mor skye phyir chags sdang mig ser 'byung*// de yang sgyu mar shes pas rab tu spang*// dus der rnam shes rlung gi bzhon pa can// yin phyir yi dam bsgom zhing bla ma dran// 'dod chags spangs pas mngal 'jug skye gnas khegs// bzhi bcu zhe dgu dag pa'i skye gnas 'grub/ ༈ /de ltar rtsa ba'i chos bzhi yan lag gnyis// don ldan yang dag bsam pa'i dge ba dang*// dus gsum bsags dang dmigs med dge ba dang*// nges pa lnga ldan rdo rje 'chang chen sogs// go 'phang bla na med pa thob phyir bsngo// zhes kha 'don du'ang bya zhing don bsgoms pas myur du sangs rgyas kyi zhing skyon thams cad dang bral ba yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa'i bdag nyid du 'gyur ro// 'dir smras pa/

zab lam gdams pa'i snying po chos drug po// ma nor blo ldan dad ldan don phyir du// 'jug bde nyung ngur byas te bkod pa 'di// thar 'dod skal ldan yongs kyi thugs la zhog /ces pa 'di chos drug gi yig cha rnying pa rnams sor bzhag |rang nyid nyams su blang ba'i phyir dang*/ gzhan yang bka' brgyud 'di nyid kyi lam srol 'dzin par 'dod pa dag gi don du dbon po thar gling pa dang*/ dge slong gling chung gnyis kyis bskul ba las/ shākya'i dge slong thabs lam 'di nyid cung zad nyams su lon pa dharma kīrtis zla dgon du sbyar ba'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
